cases.title: Robot connection
cases.objective: Verify adapter initialization and connection to the physical robot.
procedure: Confirm robot is powered, on stable ground, and emergency stop is reachable.
Start the selected humanoid-core robot connection example or operator-approved application.
Connect to the robot using the documented network configuration.
Record connection result, latency, logs, and robot state snapshot.
cases.expected_result: Connection completes without SDK leakage, uncaught exception, or unsafe motion.
safety_notes: Do not execute motion commands during connection validation.
Keep a human operator within emergency-stop reach.

cases.title: Reconnect after network interruption
cases.objective: Verify automatic reconnect and state recovery after a short network outage.
procedure: Connect to the robot and confirm heartbeat is active.
Disconnect Ethernet or disable Wi-Fi for 10 seconds.
Restore network connectivity.
Observe reconnect behavior and state synchronization.
cases.expected_result: Framework reports disconnection, reconnects within the configured policy, and resumes read-only state updates.
safety_notes: Robot must remain stationary.
Do not combine with motion validation.

cases.title: Heartbeat timeout
cases.objective: Verify heartbeat timeout detection and Result status mapping.
procedure: Connect to the robot.
Block robot network traffic using an approved lab network method.
Wait longer than the configured timeout.
Record reported status and recovery behavior.
cases.expected_result: Timeout is reported without process crash or stale connected state.
safety_notes: Use lab-approved network controls only.

cases.title: Power cycle recovery
cases.objective: Verify framework behavior when the robot is power cycled.
procedure: Connect and confirm stable telemetry.
Power down the robot using vendor-safe procedure.
Power up the robot and wait for network availability.
Record reconnect result and state freshness.
cases.expected_result: Framework detects loss, does not issue commands, and supports operator-controlled reconnect.
safety_notes: Follow vendor power-cycle procedure.
Stabilize the robot before reconnect.

cases.title: Multiple reconnect cycles
cases.objective: Verify repeated reconnect behavior across multiple network interruptions.
procedure: Perform 10 controlled disconnect and reconnect cycles.
Record each disconnect timestamp and reconnect timestamp.
Confirm state manager freshness after each cycle.
cases.expected_result: No resource leak, deadlock, crash, or stale connected state is observed.
safety_notes: Robot must remain stationary.

cases.title: Battery and charging state
cases.objective: Verify battery level and charging state mapping into RobotState.
procedure: Connect to the robot with telemetry enabled.
Record reported battery percentage and charging flag.
Compare against vendor display or approved operator reference.
cases.expected_result: Battery and charging values are plausible and timestamped.
safety_notes: Do not begin motion validation below the site-defined battery threshold.

cases.title: IMU and orientation state
cases.objective: Verify roll, pitch, and yaw are populated consistently.
procedure: Place robot in a stable standing or supported posture.
Record orientation telemetry for 60 seconds.
Optionally apply small operator-approved posture changes.
cases.expected_result: Orientation values are timestamped and change consistently with observed posture.
safety_notes: Use support equipment when required by robot safety procedure.

cases.title: Fault and emergency-stop state
cases.objective: Verify emergency stop and fault state propagation.
procedure: Connect to the robot in a safe stationary state.
Trigger an approved non-destructive fault or emergency-stop condition.
Record RobotState emergencyStop and faultCode fields.
Clear the condition using approved recovery procedure.
cases.expected_result: Fault and emergency-stop state are visible and cleared only after operator recovery.
safety_notes: Use only approved safety devices and non-destructive faults.

cases.title: Telemetry latency and packet loss
cases.objective: Measure telemetry update latency and packet loss under stable network conditions.
procedure: Start telemetry logging for at least 10 minutes.
Record message timestamps and operator host timestamps.
Compute latency distribution and missed update estimate.
cases.expected_result: Latency and loss remain within the release acceptance threshold.
safety_notes: Do not run high-speed motion during latency baseline.

cases.title: Stand command
cases.objective: Verify stand command execution through humanoid-core adapter path.
procedure: Prepare robot on approved test surface.
Execute the stand command once.
Observe robot posture and command Result.
Record video and logs.
cases.expected_result: Robot reaches expected standing state or reports a safe failure.
safety_notes: Use spotters and emergency stop.
Keep the test area clear.

cases.title: Sit command
cases.objective: Verify sit command execution and terminal state.
procedure: Start from approved standing state.
Execute sit command.
Record command result and final RobotState.
cases.expected_result: Robot reaches expected sitting state or reports a safe failure.
safety_notes: Use vendor-approved surface and clearance.

cases.title: Directional walk commands
cases.objective: Validate forward, backward, left, right, and rotate command mapping.
procedure: Mark a safe walking area.
Execute each direction at low velocity.
Stop between directions.
Record observed direction and velocity telemetry.
cases.expected_result: Robot motion direction matches command intent and stop returns robot to safe state.
safety_notes: Use low speed first.
Abort on drift, instability, or unexpected acceleration.

cases.title: Emergency stop during motion
cases.objective: Verify command rejection and safe stop behavior after emergency stop.
procedure: Execute low-speed motion.
Activate emergency stop using approved procedure.
Attempt a new motion command after emergency stop is active.
Record safety validator and adapter responses.
cases.expected_result: Motion stops and subsequent unsafe commands are rejected until recovery.
safety_notes: Spotters and emergency stop operator are mandatory.

cases.title: Repeated motion execution 100 cycles
cases.objective: Validate repeated command lifecycle and resource stability.
procedure: Execute approved low-risk stand-stop or move-stop sequence 100 times.
Record failures, latency, CPU, RAM, and robot thermal observations.
Stop immediately on abnormal motion or fault.
cases.expected_result: No command lifecycle leak, crash, overheating, or unsafe behavior is observed.
safety_notes: Operator may mark SKIPPED if site policy prohibits repetition.

cases.title: Repeated motion execution 1000 cycles
cases.objective: Validate long repeated command execution under controlled conditions.
procedure: Execute the approved low-risk cycle 1000 times or until site limit.
Record every failure, timeout, or operator abort.
Capture resource and thermal samples periodically.
cases.expected_result: The sequence completes or is stopped by documented operator decision without framework instability.
safety_notes: Requires safety lead approval.
Abort on thermal, battery, or stability limits.

cases.title: Open and close hand
cases.objective: Verify hand open and close command mapping where supported.
procedure: Confirm robot hand capability is advertised.
Execute open command and record result.
Execute close command and record result.
cases.expected_result: Supported commands complete; unsupported commands are rejected explicitly.
safety_notes: Keep hands clear of pinch points.

cases.title: Grip and release
cases.objective: Validate grip and release command behavior with approved test object.
procedure: Place approved test object in robot hand.
Execute grip command.
Execute release command.
Record object handling result.
cases.expected_result: Object interaction matches configured capability or returns safe unsupported result.
safety_notes: Use soft approved test object only.

cases.title: Playback, stop, volume, mute
cases.objective: Verify audio adapter lifecycle and parameter validation.
procedure: Play approved audio sample.
Adjust volume within allowed range.
Mute and unmute.
Stop playback.
cases.expected_result: Audio commands complete or return explicit unsupported status without robot instability.
safety_notes: Respect site sound-level policy.

cases.title: Invalid audio input
cases.objective: Verify invalid audio commands are rejected safely.
procedure: Submit invalid audio identifier or invalid volume value.
Record command result.
Confirm no crash and no unexpected playback.
cases.expected_result: Invalid input is rejected with a framework error result.
safety_notes: Do not use extreme volume values on physical speakers.

cases.title: Mission loading and execution
cases.objective: Verify mission file loading and command-framework execution path.
procedure: Load an approved mission file.
Validate schema before execution.
Execute mission under operator supervision.
Record lifecycle status and command results.
cases.expected_result: Mission reaches Completed or a documented safe failure state.
safety_notes: Review every command in the mission before execution.

cases.title: Pause, resume, and cancel
cases.objective: Validate mission control operations.
procedure: Start approved mission.
Pause mission during a safe step.
Resume mission.
Cancel mission and verify terminal state.
cases.expected_result: Mission lifecycle transitions match requested operation and do not bypass command safety.
safety_notes: Use low-risk mission content.

cases.title: Retry, loop, timeout, and nested mission
cases.objective: Validate mission flow-control behavior.
procedure: Load approved mission templates covering retry, loop, timeout, and nested mission behavior.
Execute each template under supervision.
Record transitions and terminal status.
cases.expected_result: Flow control follows mission policy and stops safely on timeout or abort policy.
safety_notes: Use hardware-safe commands in flow-control missions.

cases.title: Composite and decorator nodes
cases.objective: Validate sequence, selector, parallel, retry, and timeout nodes.
procedure: Load approved behavior tree examples.
Execute trees through runtime integration.
Record node statuses and terminal result.
cases.expected_result: Behavior tree lifecycle matches expected node semantics.
safety_notes: Use command nodes only with approved safe commands.

cases.title: Mission, command, and condition nodes
cases.objective: Validate leaf node integration with mission, command, and runtime context.
procedure: Execute tree with MissionNode, CommandNode, and ConditionNode.
Change condition input through approved runtime blackboard setup.
Record resulting branch selection and command execution.
cases.expected_result: Leaf nodes use existing framework services and do not bypass safety validation.
safety_notes: Review all mission and command content before execution.

cases.title: Goal to execution pipeline
cases.objective: Validate Goal to Mission to BehaviorTree to Execution flow.
procedure: Submit an approved goal such as Wave to audience.
Review generated mission and behavior tree before execution.
Execute only after operator approval.
Record diagnostics and execution result.
cases.expected_result: Planner produces a valid plan and execution follows existing runtime paths.
safety_notes: Do not execute planner output without human review.

cases.title: Camera and lighting conditions
cases.objective: Validate camera frame routing under normal, dark, backlight, and outdoor conditions.
procedure: Start approved camera sensor backend.
Capture frames in each lighting condition.
Record frame timestamps, dropped frames, and operator image-quality notes.
cases.expected_result: Frames are timestamped and routed without framework crash or stale health state.
safety_notes: Do not record sensitive personal data without site approval.

cases.title: Detection and sensor fusion
cases.objective: Validate detection result and fusion output contracts with approved backends.
procedure: Run approved YOLO, face, pose, QR, AprilTag, and fusion adapters where available.
Record detection confidence, labels, timestamps, and tracking identifiers.
Compare against operator truth set.
cases.expected_result: Backends produce framework-owned DetectionResult records or explicit unsupported status.
safety_notes: Respect privacy and site data policy.

cases.title: ROS2 bridge topics, services, actions, RViz, and launch
cases.objective: Validate optional ROS2 bridge operation in a ROS2 environment.
procedure: Source the ROS2 environment.
Start the humanoid-core ROS2 launch file.
Verify documented topics, services, and actions.
Open RViz configuration and verify visual status outputs.
Restart bridge and record recovery behavior.
cases.expected_result: ROS2 bridge exposes documented contracts without requiring ROS2 in core framework targets.
safety_notes: Do not execute motion actions without robot safety approval.

cases.title: Fleet, REST, gRPC, WebSocket, OTA, dashboard, auth, and RBAC
cases.objective: Validate optional cloud platform contracts in a deployment environment.
procedure: Deploy approved cloud backend or contract test harness.
Register robot and verify fleet status.
Exercise REST, gRPC, and WebSocket contract paths.
Verify OTA planning, dashboard backend metadata, authentication, and RBAC decisions.
cases.expected_result: Cloud components honor optional dependency boundaries and enforce deployment authentication policy.
safety_notes: Remote control must remain disabled unless approved by the safety lead.

cases.title: Continuous runtime stress
cases.objective: Observe runtime stability for 4, 8, 12, and 24 hour windows.
procedure: Start approved long-running workload.
Record CPU, RAM, thermal, network, command, mission, and telemetry metrics.
Checkpoint at 4, 8, 12, and 24 hours or site-approved duration.
Stop on safety, battery, thermal, or network limits.
cases.expected_result: No memory leak, deadlock, unbounded resource growth, or unsafe robot behavior is observed.
safety_notes: A human operator must monitor robot safety throughout hardware stress tests.

cases.title: Network, process, disk, configuration, battery, and robot restart faults
cases.objective: Validate framework failure handling under controlled fault injection.
procedure: Inject one approved fault at a time: Ethernet disconnect, Wi-Fi disable, SDK restart, robot restart, low battery, latency, packet loss, process kill, runtime kill, disk full, or configuration corruption.
Record framework response, operator intervention, recovery result, and data integrity.
Return system to baseline before the next fault.
cases.expected_result: Faults are detected, unsafe commands are rejected, and recovery is explicit and traceable.
safety_notes: Do not inject faults during high-risk motion.
Low-battery tests require safety lead approval.
